title: Settings
subtitle: Organisation-wide rules. Every save needs a reason and is recorded in the audit log.

duty.title: Duty hours
duty.desc: When staff are on duty. Location is only collected inside these hours.

cash.title: Cash on hand
cash.desc: How much cash a collector may hold before depositing.

collections.title: Collections
collections.desc: Checks applied to money recorded in the field.

customers.title: Customers
customers.desc: Which customers field staff see in the app, and when their map pins need a manager.

tags.title: Bad-customer tags
tags.desc: Who may tag customers and whether a manager must approve.

promises.title: Promises to pay
promises.desc: Limits for promise dates staff can record.

location.title: Location
location.desc: Duty-hour tracking frequency, accuracy and how long points are kept.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.desc: Proof required when staff start work.

cowork.title: Co-work
cowork.desc: How visits count when several staff work together in the field. Collected money is never shared.

reports.title: Reports
reports.desc: Leaderboard visibility and the data quality check.

app.title: Staff app
app.desc: Older app versions are asked to update before they can sync.

other.title: Other settings
other.desc: Read-only here; managed by the system team.

branches.title: Branch map points
branches.desc: The ERP keeps no coordinates for branches. Set each branch's point here: maps open there and the data-quality check measures customers' distance from it.

duty.weeklyOff.label: Weekly days off
duty.weeklyOff.help: No duty, no tracking on these days.

duty.lateGraceMin.label: Late after
duty.lateGraceMin.help: Minutes after shift start before work-in counts as late.

duty.maxBreakMin.label: Longest break
duty.maxBreakMin.help: Total break minutes per day before it is flagged.

cash.limitPoisha.label: Default cash limit
cash.limitPoisha.help: Used for collectors without their own limit.

cash.warnAtRatio.label: Warn at
cash.warnAtRatio.help: Percent of the limit at which the collector and manager are warned.

collections.farFromPinM.label: Far from pin
collections.farFromPinM.help: Collections recorded further than this from the customer's pin are flagged.

collections.photoRequiredAbovePoisha.label: Receipt photo above
collections.photoRequiredAbovePoisha.help: 0 means a photo is never required.

tags.staffCanSet.label: Field staff can tag
tags.staffCanSet.help: If off, only managers tag customers.

tags.approvalMode.label: Manager approval
tags.approvalMode.help: Tags by staff wait for a manager before they apply.

promises.graceDays.label: Grace before broken
promises.graceDays.help: Days after the promise date before it is marked broken.

location.trackingProvider.label: Tracking engine
location.trackingProvider.help: Background location library the staff app uses. Switch to the paid engine once its licence is bought; apps pick it up on their next settings refresh.

attendance.selfieRequired.label: Photo required for attendance
attendance.selfieRequired.help: When on, staff must take a front-camera photo at the moments picked below. Attendance without a photo is still saved, but flagged.

attendance.selfieEvents.label: When a photo is needed
attendance.selfieEvents.help: Pick any of work start, break, back to work and work end.

cowork.visitCredit.label: Credit for a joint visit
cowork.visitCredit.help: How much one joint visit counts towards each participant's visit target. 100% is a full visit, 50% half, 0% none (it still shows in reports). Branches can have their own value on the server.

cowork.maxMembers.label: Largest co-work group
cowork.maxMembers.help: Including the person who asks. People who have not answered yet count too.

reports.leaderboardVisibleToStaff.label: Field staff can see the leaderboard
reports.leaderboardVisibleToStaff.help: Managers always see it. When on, staff see their own branch in the app.

reports.leaderboardMinPresentDays.label: Days present to be ranked
reports.leaderboardMinPresentDays.help: Staff present fewer days in the period are listed without a rank. 0 ranks everyone.

reports.dataQualityMaxBranchKm.label: Farthest pin from the branch
reports.dataQualityMaxBranchKm.help: A customer pin further than this from its branch is reported in Data quality.

customers.staffVisibility.label: Customers field staff see
customers.staffVisibility.help: Whole branch: every customer of their branches, assigned or not. Assigned only: just the customers assigned to them (the old rule). Today in the app always lists their own customers.

customers.staffPinApproval.label: Staff map pins
customers.staffPinApproval.help: A pin for a customer with no usable location can apply at once; moving an existing pin always waits for a manager.

enum.when_missing: Apply at once when the customer has no pin

errors.shiftOrder: Must be after the shift start.
errors.slowFast: Must be at least the moving interval.
errors.selfieEvents: Pick at least one moment while photos are required.

branchPoint.missingCount_one: {{n}} location has no map point yet.
branchPoint.missingCount_other: {{n}} locations have no map point yet.
branchPoint.title: Map point of {{name}}
branchPoint.desc: Move the map under the pin to the branch office, or paste its coordinates.
branchPoint.mapLabel: Map to set the point of {{name}}
branchPoint.pasteHelp: For example 22.70123, 90.37011 or a map link.
branchPoint.pasteError: These are not coordinates we can read.
